# KRN repository rules

- **KRN-05** When core code is changed, the author MUST keep imports within core _(owner: author; test: core imports only its own files, including nested files and every module form; Core stays independent of replaceable adapters.)_
- **KRN-06** When the CLI receives an unknown command, the CLI MUST forward it to the configured legacy entry with a recursion guard _(owner: CLI; test: unknown commands forward arguments, streams, and exit code to the legacy binary; The strangler CLI preserves unmigrated commands.)_
- **KRN-07** When review is complete and a change is ready for integration, the author MUST pass `npm run gate:local` _(owner: author; gate: npm run gate:local; Required CI on the exact HEAD is the full Product gate (D30); after review the lead runs preflight and only isolation test files with zero isolation skips under `krn host-lock run --name gate -- npm run gate:local`.)_
- **KRN-08** When agent state is written for this repository, the author MUST keep agent state under `.krn/` _(owner: author; test: project tools ignore nested worktree state; Agent state is repository-local and stays outside tracked project inputs.)_
- **KRN-09** When the lead works in this repository, the lead MUST follow `docs/program/lead-rules.md` for evidence, proposals, handoffs, and delivery _(owner: lead; none: manual review; Lead methods have one durable owner.)_
- **KRN-10** When an agent works in this repository, the agent MUST follow `docs/program/repository-workflow.md` for the local KRN delivery process and terminal PR closeout _(owner: all KRN roles; none: manual review; KRN process belongs only in repositories that explicitly adopt it; the global contract stays universal and minimal.)_
- **KRN-11** When a work item is managed, the lead MUST manage task status in `tasks/<id>.json` with `krn task` (`ready`, `claim`, `release`, `close`); workers MUST NOT mutate tracker state, must receive the task id in their brief, and MUST use it in commit titles and the `Ticket:` trailer _(owner: lead; test: repository rules document task delivery and receiver proof; Work status travels with the repository and delivery remains traceable to its task.)_
- **KRN-12** When code is integrated or forwarded, the author MUST test every integration or forward against its real receiver or a verbatim capture of its output _(owner: author; test: repository rules document task delivery and receiver proof; Receiver-boundary evidence verifies integration and forwarding contracts.)_
<!-- krn-agent-workflow:end -->
